learner_starting_state: Can handle JSON-shaped data and explain an offline client flow but has not mapped common text-analysis goals to capabilities.
learner_ending_state: Can select key phrase extraction, named entity recognition, sentiment analysis, or summarization and trace a lightweight document-ID/result/error flow.
mastery_gate: Score 12 of 12 on primary and fresh-transfer forms, demonstrate all four required text techniques on both forms, pass both client-flow items, and explain one choice without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: AI-901 technique wording and Azure Language capabilities trace to current official Microsoft sources; scenarios, distractors, reasons, and gates are course-authored.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify SDK packages, operation names, endpoints, authentication, languages, limits, regions, pricing, and preview status before live implementation.

notes: Offline scenario and structured-result package; performs no service call.
